Subject: Ausmus for web

By Anthony Fenech
Detroit Free Press
The new general manager wants a new manager.

That was the late-night report from Ch. 4’s Bernie Smilovitz, who said that a front-office source within the Tigers front office has said that he will be out as Tigers manager at the end of the 2015 season.
Asked tonight in a text message, Ausmus said he did not have a comment.
Asked earlier this week about the frequency in which he spoke with team owner Mike Ilitch, Ausmus said, “That’s personal. Sorry.”

Ausmus had a 154-147 in one-plus season as Tigers manager, which included a postseason loss to the Orioles in the 2014 American League Division Series, and a last-place standing in the AL Central after tonight’s game.
